title: 第1章 天命大反派第2章 仙古顾家
lines: 【脑子寄存处】
【种图区，种下一张图，长出千千万】
“逆徒，你再这样，我要赶不上早朝了。”
无上神朝，女帝寝宫之中。
抱着香软玉体的顾云悠悠转醒。
在他的怀中，乃是一位貌美若仙子一般的美妇人，此刻粉面羞红，哝哝开口。
顾云起身，将散落一旁的华服穿上，英俊无比，气势不凡。
而柳宵月也坐起身子，慵懒倚在龙榻边缘，此刻的她一袭宽松睡袍，气质高贵，如九天之上的玄女一般。
睡袍斜斜耷拉着，露出半边锁骨白皙如玉。
整个人就如同完全熟透的果实，轻纱半掩，难掩媚意，杏眸灵动，美丽动人。
龙塌旁还随意散落着一条龙袍和一个冠冕，看上去有些破损。
柳宵月的目光落在顾云身上，满是柔情，唇间带着几分不舍：
“云儿，此时去？何时回？”
“师尊，顾家祖训，族中少主修成炼虚境后，皆需前往下界试炼，掌控一域核心本源、突破合体境方能归来。”
“就算是我，也得遵守祖训，不过我认为，大概……一年时间就差不多了。”
顾家子弟自然需要事事争先，合体境作为所有修炼境界中打基础的最重要一环，合体灵物的选择至关重要。
小世界之灵就是最好的合体灵物，尤其是对于顾云而言，此等灵物属性兼备，不会有短板，炼化后顾云不仅能铸就无上体魄，还能与那一方小世界相连，动辄瞬移千万里不成问题，可攻可守，极为完备。
“一年？太久了……”
以往的仙古顾家帝子下界历练，动辄十年起步，而顾云却说只需要一年。
如此自负的话语，落到柳宵月的耳中却未觉丝毫意外，甚至觉得有点太久了。
她可不想要和自己的宝贝徒儿分开，这么多年，从顾云三岁开始，自己都得抱着对方入眠，每年顾云回家省亲的日子都让她心痒难耐，现如今要与好徒儿分别一年之久，自己龙塌空空，无人相陪，岂不是寂寞的要命？
感受到师尊落寞的情绪，顾云回身揽住柳宵月，将她柔软的身躯紧贴入怀，轻笑安抚。
“师尊，俗话说的好，小别胜新婚，离别是为了更好的重逢，师尊该祝福我才是。”
柳宵月嗔怪地轻捶了他几下，娇声抱怨：“哼，小没良心的东西，我看着你长大，如今却要离别这般久，都不允许我伤怀一下吗？”
顾云轻笑，手指滑过她柔软的脊背，低声打趣：“徒儿自是能感受到师尊的拳拳情谊，只是师尊这般尽力挽留，徒儿我都有点不想下界了。”
柳宵月白了顾云一眼，这个小冤家还真好意思说。
虽然一开始的确是她有些出格的举动吧，引诱顾云走入深渊，但是后来这个小冤家就一改一开始的青涩腼腆，知识极其丰富，一套一套的，自己都不知道小小年纪顾云都是从何处习得的，将自己都带坏了，被吃得死死的，必须嗅闻对方身上的味道才能够入眠。
“哼，”柳宵月微微调整情绪，故作冷然：“正好你离开这段时间，本宫也该歇一歇了。”
话虽如此，但柳宵月终究不舍，深深叮嘱道：“此去下界，千万小心。虽说那下界贫瘠，但也不乏险恶，最重要的是人心难测，你可一定要注意自身的安全。”
顾云听罢，眼中带笑，话语轻松：“师尊大可放心，徒儿已是炼虚境修为，以徒儿的战力，小小一方下界又有何危险可言？”
“不行！我还是有些担心，此事非同小可，绝非儿戏！”柳宵月俏脸严肃，沉声说道：“影儿，你跟着他。”
话音刚落，一名黑衣女子自暗处闪身而出。
女子身姿曼妙，黑色劲装紧贴身躯，勾勒出玲珑曲线，虽是戴着面纱看不清容貌，但仅凭其傲人的身段便足以令无数男人目不转睛。
“影儿好不好看？”
见顾云的目光停留在影儿的身上，柳宵月不禁凑到顾云耳边调侃。
“没有师尊好看。”顾云实话实说，语气坦荡。
“算你还有点良心，不过我偷偷告诉你，影儿是可以的哦。”
柳宵月心花怒放，只觉如吃了蜜糖一般甜腻，在顾云耳畔嚼道，随后在其脸颊上吻了一下，走到影儿的身边。
“影儿你是圣人王境的修为，以下界的位面层次定然承受不住，还要做些准备。”
content_en:
【Brain Storage】
[Picture planting area, plant a picture, and thousands will grow]
"Traitor, if you keep doing this, I won't be able to make it to the morning meeting."
The supreme divine dynasty, in the palace of the empress.
Gu Yun woke up leisurely holding the fragrant soft jade body.
In his arms was a beautiful woman who was as beautiful as a fairy. Her face was blushing and she was mumbling.
Gu Yun stood up and put on the scattered Chinese clothes. He was extremely handsome and impressive.
Liu Xiaoyue also sat up and leaned lazily on the edge of the dragon couch. At this moment, she was wearing a loose nightgown, with a noble temperament, like a mysterious goddess above the nine heavens.
The nightgown hung sideways, revealing half of her collarbone, which was as white as jade.
The whole person is like a completely ripe fruit, with the gauze half-covered, unable to hide the charm, and the apricot eyes are smart and beautiful.
There was also a dragon robe and a crown scattered randomly next to the dragon collapse, which looked a little damaged.
Liu Xiaoyue's eyes fell on Gu Yun, full of tenderness, with a bit of reluctance on her lips:
"Yun'er, are you leaving now? When will you come back?"
"Master, according to the ancestral teachings of the Gu family, after the young masters of the clan have reached the Void Refining Realm, they all need to go to the lower realm for trials, master the core origin of a domain, and break through the Fusion Realm before they can return."
"Even I have to abide by the ancestral precepts, but I think... about a year will be enough."
The children of the Gu family naturally need to be first in everything. The Fusion Realm is the most important part of laying the foundation for all cultivation realms, and the choice of the Fusion Spiritual Object is crucial.
The spirit of the small world is the best combined spiritual object, especially for Gu Yun. Such spiritual objects have both attributes and will have no shortcomings. After refining, Gu Yun can not only build a supreme body, but also be connected to the small world on that side. It is not a problem to teleport thousands of miles. It can be attacked and defended, and it is extremely complete.
"One year? Too long..."
In the past, it would take ten years for the emperors of the Immortal Gu family to experience the lower world, but Gu Yun said it would only take one year.
Such conceited words fell into Liu Xiaoyue's ears, but she was not surprised at all. She even felt that they were a bit too long.
She didn't want to be separated from her precious disciple. For so many years, since Gu Yun was three years old, she had to hug him to sleep. Every year when Gu Yun went home to visit his relatives, it made her feel unbearable. Now that she has to be separated from her good disciple for a year, she is empty and empty, with no one to accompany her. Isn't it terribly lonely?
Feeling his master's lonely mood, Gu Yun turned around and hugged Liu Xiaoyue, holding her soft body close to his chest and smiling softly to comfort her.
"Master, as the saying goes, a short farewell is better than a new marriage. Parting is for a better reunion. Master should bless me."
Liu Xiaoyue punched him a few times angrily, and complained softly: "Humph, you little heartless thing, I watched you grow up, and now you have to be apart for so long, don't you allow me to feel sad for you?"
Gu Yun chuckled, ran his fingers across her soft back, and joked in a low voice: "Disciple can certainly feel Master's friendship, but Master is trying his best to retain me, Disciple, I don't want to go down to the next world."
Liu Xiaoyue rolled her eyes at Gu Yun, this little enemy was really embarrassed to say it.
Although it was true that she did some outrageous things at the beginning, luring Gu Yun into the abyss, but later this little enemy changed from the young and shy at the beginning, and became extremely knowledgeable. She didn't know where Gu Yun learned all these things at a young age.
"Huh," Liu Xiaoyue adjusted her mood slightly and pretended to be cold: "It's just the time you're away. It's time for me to take a rest."
Even so, Liu Xiaoyue refused to give up after all, and deeply warned: "Be careful when going to the lower realm. Although the lower realm is barren, it is also dangerous. The most important thing is that people's hearts are unpredictable. You must pay attention to your own safety."
After listening to this, Gu Yun had a smile in his eyes and spoke easily: "Master, you can rest assured, my disciple has already cultivated in the Void Refining Realm. With my disciple's fighting power, what danger is there for a small person in the lower realm?"
"No! I'm still a little worried. This matter is no trivial matter, no child's play!" Liu Xiaoyue's pretty face was serious and she said in a deep voice: "Ying'er, follow him."
"Yes!"
As soon as he finished speaking, a woman in black emerged from the darkness.
The woman has a graceful figure, and the black dress is tight to the body, outlining the exquisite curves. Although she is wearing a veil and cannot see her face clearly, her proud figure alone is enough to make countless men stare.
"Is Ying'er good-looking?"
Seeing Gu Yun's eyes lingering on Ying'er, Liu Xiaoyue couldn't help teasing her in Gu Yun's ear.
"Not as good-looking as Master." Gu Yun told the truth, with a magnanimous tone.
"You still have some conscience, but let me tell you secretly, Ying'er is okay."
Liu Xiaoyue was so excited that she felt as sweet as eating honey. She chewed it in Gu Yun's ear, then kissed him on the cheek and walked to Ying'er's side.
"Ying'er, you are a Saint King. You will definitely not be able to withstand the levels of the lower realms, so you need to make some preparations."
